signature.name: VTask.IsConstant
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> {l : Filter α} -> (P : l.Germ β) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The predicate is well-defined on all germs without restriction and introduces no junk-value or edge-value conventions.

facts.statement: ∀ (α β γ : Type*) (l : Filter α) (lc : Filter γ) (f : α → β) (g : γ → α), VTask.IsConstant (↑f : Filter.Germ l β) → Filter.Tendsto g lc l → VTask.IsConstant (↑(f ∘ g) : Filter.Germ lc β)
